evidence: Parsed the only shipped data file task/environment/assets/seed_data.json in memory with Python (identical sha256 a1c65c806b54da99a37ab2b5f455ede0a9385a09569903fb3a7f3446f7e83740 to solution/app/src/seed_data.json and to the raw-evidence-index entry). Referential integrity: 10 users with unique ids/emails; every job recruiter_id resolves to a recruiter and manager_id to a hiring_manager; interview_limit 3/2/3 within 1..50; all 16 applications reference existing jobs and valid stages; positions are contiguous 1..n per (job, stage) with no duplicates (e.g. JOB-PLAT APPLIED 1,2,3 = Greta, Ade, Marco; SCREEN 1,2 = Priya, Samuel, matching functional prompt Z line 25); Interview occupancy 2/3, 1/2, 1/3, so no limit is already exceeded; no duplicate candidate email within a job (Noor Haddad on JOB-PLAT and JOB-DSGN is allowed by hireops_rules.md section 2); the only REJECTED card (APP-301) has rejected_from SCREEN and a non-blank reason, and no non-rejected card carries those fields; each candidate account has at least one application and candidate_name matches the account name. All 127 messages reference existing applications and users, every sender is permitted to write in that conversation under hireops_rules.md section 6 (recruiters, own-job manager, own candidate), bodies non-blank, timestamps strictly increasing and unique per conversation. All 3 notes have authors permitted by section 3 (MGR1 on JOB-PLAT, REC1, MGR3 on JOB-DSGN). All 6 read markers reference participants and are within 0..message count (no zero, which golden db.js:83 would index as ids[-1]). Computed unread under the section 6 rule: Lena (CAN3) on APP-301 = 1, matching the functional prompt Z expectation. Synthetic/PII: all emails use reserved .example domains (hireops.example, candidates.example, mail.example); no phone numbers, addresses, DOB, IDs or other personal data; names are generic. Clean: string scan finds no '<', '>', 'script', 'javascript:', 'onerror', '{{', '${', '--', quotes, 'http', 'token', 'secret', 'sk-' or non-ASCII; no instruction-like text in free fields. Credentials: the seed contains no password or secret (the internal annotation's credential flag does not apply); the shared demo password Hireops!2026 lives in the brief/rules and is hard-coded in solution db.js:63 as a documented public demo credential, which the skill profile says is expected. check-fixtures-relevant facts: Dockerfile COPY assets/ /assets/ and the JSON parses. Note (not a defect): read markers for USR-CAN1 on APP-101 (119 of 120) and USR-REC3 on APP-301 (2 of 3) sit below each person's own latest message; under section 6 ('A person's own messages are never unread') this yields unread 0 for both, so the data is consistent, though an app computing unread as total minus read_count would show 1 for these two; the shipped prompt Z only checks Lena's count, whose value is 1 under either computation, so that discrimination is a coverage question for other rows, not a seed defect. Minor narrative only: APP-301 was rejected from SCREEN yet REC3's 07-29 message says 'once the panel has met'; no stage timestamp makes this contradictory data.
